title: 翻页
summary: 一批记录先问整页替换还是末尾追加。翻页会丢掉上一页并回到顶部；追加只增加 visibleCount，旧节点不卸。
summaryEn: A batch of records first asks: replace the page, or append at the end? Paging drops the previous page and returns to the top; append only grows visibleCount, and old nodes stay mounted.
asks: 这一批记录是整页替换，还是末尾追加？
asksEn: Does this batch of records replace the page, or append at the end?
